description: This Java class defines an adapter, 'ThingErrorResponseAdapter', responsible for converting between 'ThingErrorResponse' objects and a generic 'Adaptable' representation within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework. It provides methods for creating adapter instances, constructing topic paths based on error responses, and building error responses from topic paths and exceptions.

classes.name: ThingErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractErrorResponseAdapter to map 'ThingErrorResponse' objects to and from an adaptable format, facilitating error handling within the Ditto protocol framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new 'ThingErrorResponseAdapter' instance, requiring a 'HeaderTranslator' and an 'ErrorRegistry' as parameters.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Returns a 'TopicPathBuilder' constructed using the 'ThingEntityId' from the 'ThingErrorResponse'.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingErrorResponse' object using the provided 'TopicPath', 'DittoRuntimeException', and 'DittoHeaders'.
